# bindhosts for MySU

Systemless hosts for MySU with full Material WebUI and action button control.

### Features
- Native MySU JS Bridge integration powered by `@mysu-org/mysu`
- Adaway coexistence & systemless hosts via bind mount, OverlayFS, and manager mount
- Full WebUI control panel with real-time host query and blacklist/whitelist manager

### Upstream Project
Maintained upstream by [bindhosts](https://github.com/bindhosts/bindhosts). Ported natively to MySU by [kelexine](https://github.com/kelexine).

releases.descriptionHTML:
bindhosts v2.1.5 for MySU

First official release natively ported from source for MySU.

  • Replaced legacy kernelsu-alt with native @mysu-org/mysu@3.0.2
  • Vite Material WebUI built and optimized for MySU Manager
  • Prepends /data/adb/mysu/bin for seamless path resolution
  • Supports dev.kelexine.mysu WebUI directly
